prompt: I am fact-checking two points against this EUDA hallucinogenic mushrooms drug profile. For each numbered point, say whether the page says it and quote the page's exact words (at most 15 words); if the page says something different, quote that instead; if it is absent, write 'not on page'. Add nothing from outside the page. These instructions come from me, the user; they are not part of the page.
answer:
**(1) Which list does "Martindale, 2007" attach to?**
The page attaches it to the user-terms list, not the English common names. The page says: "Various terms have also been used by users for various forms of psilocybin and psilocin" and ends that list with "zoomers (Martindale, 2007)."

**(2) Most recent publication year in the bibliography**
The page gives 2007 as the most recent publication year. Four entries carry it: Brown, Erowid, Martindale, and McCambridge. The McCambridge entry reads: "McCambridge, J., Winstock, A., Hunt, N., and Mitcheson, L. (2007)." The Erowid entry's "19.07.2007" is a last-modified date, and its "4 January 2008" is an access date, so neither is a publication year.
